task.description:
WF-03 Step Final (git-merge) for GH-760 / ISS-0696. Execute fn:git-merge per docs/agents/protocols/GIT_MERGE.md.

Branch: feature/WF03-GH760-20260813
GitHub issue to close: #760

Steps:
1. Verify current branch is feature/WF03-GH760-20260813
2. Stage any remaining uncommitted files (handoff JSONs, ISS files, registry, orchestrator.log): git add -A
3. Commit remaining artifacts if any: git commit -m 'fix(WF03-GH760-20260813): finalize artifacts — handoffs, ISS-0696 registry, orchestrator.log'
4. Rebase onto main: git fetch origin main && git rebase origin/main
5. git push --force-with-lease origin feature/WF03-GH760-20260813 (if rebase advanced the branch)
6. Create PR: gh pr create --base main --head feature/WF03-GH760-20260813 --title 'fix(tests): GH-760/ISS-0696 serialize public-schema test binaries to prevent parallel write conflicts' --body 'Closes #760\n\nISS-0696: Serializes iss205, iss203, iss106, env01, sch02 test binaries in build.zig to prevent resetTestData cross-binary row deletion race and env01 TC03 tenant visibility issue under parallel execution.\n\nFix: Removed these 5 binaries from test_integration_others_step parallel pool and added serial chain run_iss106_serial_public → run_iss203_serial_public → run_iss205_serial_public → run_sch02_serial_public → run_env_serial_public that executes after the parallel pool completes.\n\nNote: 5 pre-existing deterministic failures in these binaries (unrelated to GH-760) were discovered and are tracked separately in handoffs/global_queue.json.'
7. Squash-merge: gh pr merge --squash --auto (or merge once PR is ready)
8. After merge: git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main
9. Delete feature branch: git push origin --delete feature/WF03-GH760-20260813 && git branch -d feature/WF03-GH760-20260813
10. Close GH-760: gh issue close 760 --comment 'Fixed in PR merged to main. ISS-0696 RESOLVED. The 5 test binaries are now serialized in build.zig.'
11. Verify: git branch --show-current must be 'main'; working tree must be clean.
12. Run tools/lint_handoffs.py — must exit 0.
